]> 06/08/2026 7:14 Another 10cm of fresh snow! .

It was snowing heavily as the resort closed yesterday and we had another 10cm of snow overnight, bringing the total for the week to 18cm. Winter might have been a little late this year, but it's well and truly arrived with the start of August.

It's currently a chilly -3 degrees in Perisher Valley and the wind is blowing from the southwest at around 15-20km/h. We're headed for a top of 3 degrees. This morning's fog is lifting as I write this and the forecast is calling for a partly cloudy day, so it should clear up and visibility will be fine.

There isn't any more snow forecast today and we should be in for a couple of clear days before the next front rolls in. Speaking of the next front, that looks to be the big one, with the Weatherzone forecast calling for between 47cm and 95cm of snow from Sunday through to Thursday next week.

The snow guns were also firing overnight to add to the natural snowfall. We have 38 lifts scheduled to run and 55 groomed runs across the resort, and the skiing and riding will be awesome. With the fresh snow, we may have additional lifts come online over the coming days, so download the Perisher App to be the first to know, and keep an eye on the lift report for real-time updates.

It will be a great day out there, so get out and enjoy it!
